name: review-pane
description: Your pull requests and merge requests beside the chat: the GitHub and GitLab ones that wait for your review, yours and the ones you take part in, with their checks, a toast when someone asks for your review, and one press to review one in the chat. /reviews opens it.

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Show the GitHub pull requests, read with gh.

gitlab.title: GitLab
gitlab.description: Show the GitLab merge requests, read with glab.

gh.title: gh command
gh.description: The GitHub CLI, signed in with gh auth login. A full path when it is not on the PATH.

glab.title: glab command
glab.description: The GitLab CLI, signed in with glab auth login. A full path when it is not on the PATH.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane looks again.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the review pane when a session starts. Where /reviews does not run, this or asking Claude for the reviews opens it.
